;; Test buggy vs correct touches?

(defn ordered [interval]
  (let [start (get interval "start")
        finish (get interval "end")]
    (if (<= start finish)
      {"start" start "end" finish}
      {"start" finish "end" start})))

(defn touches-buggy [current next tolerance]
  (<= (get next "start")
      (+ (get current "end") (- tolerance 1))))

(defn touches-fixed [current next tolerance]
  (<= (get next "start")
      (+ (get current "end") tolerance)))

(defn extend [current next]
  {"start" (get current "start")
   "end" (max (get current "end") (get next "end"))})

(defn merge-ordered [intervals tolerance touches-fn]
  (reduce
    (fn [merged interval]
      (if (empty? merged)
        [interval]
        (let [current (last merged)]
          (if (touches-fn current interval tolerance)
            (conj (vec (butlast merged)) (extend current interval))
            (conj merged interval)))))
    []
    intervals))

(defn merge-with [input touches-fn]
  (let [tolerance (get input "tolerance" 0)
        intervals (map ordered (get input "intervals" []))
        sorted (sort-by #(get % "start") intervals)]
    {"intervals" (merge-ordered sorted tolerance touches-fn)}))

;; Test index 33 - tolerance=0, adjacent intervals
(def inp33 {"intervals" [{"end" 20261696 "start" 20261699} {"end" 20261694 "start" 20261691} {"end" 20261697 "start" 20261694}] "tolerance" 0})
(println "Buggy33:" (json/generate-string (merge-with inp33 touches-buggy)))
(println "Fixed33:" (json/generate-string (merge-with inp33 touches-fixed)))

;; Test index 26 - tolerance=2
(def inp26 {"intervals" [{"end" 20261556 "start" 20261559} {"end" 20261554 "start" 20261551} {"end" 20261557 "start" 20261555}] "tolerance" 2})
(println "Buggy26:" (json/generate-string (merge-with inp26 touches-buggy)))
(println "Fixed26:" (json/generate-string (merge-with inp26 touches-fixed)))
